title: StaticFiles symlink support: merge, security reversal, and opt-in redesign

boundary_decision.rationale: The second pull request explicitly follows the reverted first attempt, while issue comments preserve the same user need and add the security constraint that changes the accepted design to opt-in.
boundary_decision.falsification: Split the case if the first reversion is shown to be unrelated to following symlinks outside the configured directory.

excluded_sources.reason: The long-lived subclass workaround was edited after later security discussion; its current body cannot be assigned safely to its original timestamp.
This comment only links an incident report; the durable security constraint is represented by a later direct maintainer statement.
Bazel confirmations strengthen demand but do not change the design state or the opt-in constraint.

source_body_history_limitations: PR bodies are mutable and GitHub's standard API does not expose their full historical text. Summaries use stable purpose statements and are cross-checked against immutable merge commits kept only as Outcome Anchors.
